description: Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct text generation on SKaiNET-transformers' commonMain llama decoder path in eager mode, loaded from the quantized GGUF checkpoint (Q4_K_M): packed Q4_K blocks served zero-copy (MAPPED) through the engine's streaming GGUF loader into the quantized matmul kernels, byte-level BPE tokenize -> 16-layer llama (2048 hidden, 32 heads / 8 KV heads GQA, tied embeddings, RoPE base 500000) -> stop-token-aware greedy/sampled decode via generateUntilStop with batched prefill. The second task 'generation' / llm/v1 blueprint after generator-smollm2-skainet, and the first on a quantized GGUF - the engine path EdgeTranslator ships, exercising the SKaiNET#1436 multi-row quant kernel arc. The checkpoint's own Llama 3 turn structure renders inside the cartridge, never in the host.

runtime_hint.note: No role:runtime artifact. Eager execution of the llama DSL network on the SKaiNET CPU backend (jdk.incubator.vector on JVM, Accelerate on Apple targets); the Kotlin library compiled per target is the runtime. Quantized Q4_K_M weights stay packed (MAPPED residency) and run on the engine's quantized matmul kernels; engine >= 0.62.1 is required (SKaiNET#1436).

skainet-transformers.description: transformers-core (OptimizedLLMRuntime, generateUntilStop, TokenizerFactory, DecoderGgufWeightLoader) and inference-llama (llama network DSL, GGUF weight mapping)

skainet.description: CPU backend, streaming GGUF loader, random-access file sources; >= 0.62.1 required for the multi-row quantized kernel fix (SKaiNET#1436); 0.62.3 buffers GGUF metadata parsing and builds the tokenizer in one pass (faster open())

llm-v1.description: The llm/v1 task profile contract, ADR-011 (this repository, profiles/llm-v1)

steps.description: Downloads the pinned Q4_K_M GGUF (revision + sha256 above) into the shared SKaiNET model cache (~/.cache/skainet/models/unsloth_Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-GGUF). The source is acceptance-required: the fetch refuses until the profile records YOUR acceptance of the Llama 3.2 Community License.
Runs the greedy end-to-end smoke test (Llama32GenerationSmokeTest, jvmTest) against the fetched GGUF: llm/v1 event contract, STOP finish, token-for-token determinism across two runs.
